title: Hojicha Pancakes
description: Moist and flavorful pancakes infused with the warm, nutty flavors of hojicha, perfect for a cozy breakfast.
instructions: 1. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and sodium bicarbonate.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, melted butter, and vanilla extract.
3. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and whisk until just combined. Do not overmix.
5. Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
6. Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
7. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
8. Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
9. Serve warm with your favorite toppings.
